preverification_events.description: A street scene at night with multiple vehicles engulfed in fire, thick smoke, and several individuals moving amidst the chaos; a parking sign is visible, indicating an urban setting. The sustained large-scale fire and presence of multiple agitated individuals suggest collective violent unrest.
A sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of fire and smoke around a vehicle at 5.5–6.0s suggests an explosion (e.g., vehicle ignition or device detonation), distinct from sustained burning.
Two figures engage in close physical contact near a parked car in a smoke-filled alley; one appears to be grabbing or striking the other, consistent with mutual combat.
A sudden, bright flash and expanding fireball erupts on the street, characteristic of an explosion (e.g., Molotov cocktail detonation), observed from an elevated angle.

A violent street riot involving multiple individuals in riot gear, fire, and vehicles; includes deployment of incendiary devices (e.g., molotovs), burning objects, and confrontational posturing by uniformed personnel.
A group of riot police in full gear advance through a street with a large fire burning on the ground; they appear to be confronting or dispersing a crowd, consistent with active riot control.

A large, sudden fireball erupts behind the motorcycle in frame f0, with rapid expansion and intense brightness characteristic of an explosion (not sustained fire), visible only in the first frame before transitioning to burning debris.

A motorcycle rider navigates through a street at night where multiple fires are burning, debris is scattered, and figures are seen moving chaotically on stairs and in the background; consistent with violent unrest or riot conditions.

A white vehicle is seen at an abnormal angle on the road with visible distortion and proximity to a marked intersection in f0 (28.0s); by f1 (28.5s), it appears stationary and misaligned, suggesting a recent collision or loss of control.

A sudden, bright flash and rapid expansion of fire/smoke erupts from the street-level scene, consistent with an explosion; visible as intense orange-white light engulfing the area in frame f3 (29.5s) and persisting through f4 (30.0s).
